title: From Carvoeiro: Benagil Caves and Praia da Marinha Boat Trip - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Explore the stunning Benagil Caves on this boat tour from Carvoeiro. Cruise into the Algar de Benagil cave and breeze by the Arches of Praia da Marinha. Go for a dip in the sea at a scenic location, when conditions are safe. 
Check-in at the activity provider's ticket booth on Carvoeiro beach. Put on a life jacket and follow your guide to the boat. Hop aboard the small but comfortable boat and set off along the coast. Pass by towering cliffs, hidden coves, and long stretches of beach with golden sand.
Take in views of the Algar Seco cave and the white sand beaches of Vale Covo and Praia do Carvalho. Capture pictures as you glide by the 63-meter tall Farol de Alfanzina lighthouse. See a cave which got its name from a sunken steamboat. 
Enter the famed Algar de Benagil cave and have time to snap some more pictures before skirting by breathtaking caves and rock formations on your way towards the unique landscape of the Arches of Praia da Marinha which is considered one of the most beautiful beaches in Europe.
Cool off on a swim stop, when sea and weather conditions are right at a safe location outside caves in turquoise waters (not mandatory, only when conditions are favorable). Return to your meeting point at the end of your tour.

title: Albufeira: Coastline and Benagil Caves Tour by Catamaran - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Start your tour from Albufeira Marina, where you'll set off on the spacious and comfortable catamaran. From here you’ll have the opportunity to enjoy the views of the beautiful rock formations and deserted beaches. The team will tell you more about our fantastic coastline and all its hidden secrets.

Soak up the views of the Algarve coastline on a guided catamaran cruise from Albufeira. Enter the Benagil Sea Cave and take in secluded beaches, rugged rock formations, and hidden swim stops.

Relax to some nice music and enjoy a cool drink. Visit the beautiful caves and rock formations as far as Benagil (Cathedral Cave). Head back east towards the marina before stopping off for a 10 minute swim in the sea.

* The duration of the trip can be in between 2 hours and 2 hours and 45 minutes.
highlights: Cruise the stunning coastline from Albufeira to Benagil on a modern catamaran
Admire sea caves, hidden beaches, and unique rock formations along the way
Enjoy a refreshing swim stop in crystal-clear Atlantic waters
Learn more from friendly, knowledgeable and local guides
* The duration of the trip can be in between 2 hours and 2 hours and 45 minutes.
includes: Snacks and drinks to purchase onboard (cash payment only)
excludes: Payment with card onboard (cash payments only)
goodToKnow: Swimming stops and entering the caves are subject to safety and sea conditions.

sampleReviews.text: Very friendly service, a spacious and comfortable catamaran with access to a bar and a restroom, as well as a shaded area. I highly recommend it. It's worth seeing when you're in the Algarve.

The activity itself was great. I rate the catamaran cruise very positively. The crew was communicative and cheerful - a big plus. The only downside in the organization: you have to be there 30 minutes in advance, and during that time they kept us in full sun, making it impossible to board. This is more of a criticism of the organizer than of the boat's staff. Overall, a pleasant time spent on the water
Fabulous experience. Totally worth it. The tour guides are very friendly and professional. The views of the caves and all the cliffs are worth every euro paid. I recommend it 100%.

It was an amazing tour! I thought it wouldn't be possible to see even more beauty in the Algarve, and the tour is undoubtedly a MUST to enjoy the full experience of what this beautiful region has to offer. Enchanting! It was the highlight of my vacation! Thank you, SeaAlgarve team. 🇵🇹😮‍💨

The tour was absolutely amazing. Even more than expected! Sea Algarve was a wonderful ship and the crew was funny and made it a wonderful experience. Thanks for a beautiful day and a one-of-kind experience!!!!

We really enjoyed this trip it was a great way to spend a birthday! We needed to rearrange because I wasn’t well and that was made really easy and we were accommodated which we really appreciated. The day its self was the perfect way to spend a more cloudy warm day in between boiling hot days . It was fun and we so so many beautiful things I’d highly recommend to everyone.
A beautiful trip along the coast. A nice boat where you weren't crammed in. The live guide was easy to understand and explained things well.
fantastic tour. really enjoyed it. nice clean modern cruise boat abd great commentary

title: Portimão: Benagil Caves & Dolphins Watching with Biologist - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Join a marine biologist for a guided tour of the Benagil Caves, lasting up to 2.5 hours. Cruise in search of dolphins, visit the stunning caves of the Algarve coast, and cruise into the iconic Algar de Benagil cave.

Set sail from Portimão and head to the Marinha beach. As you sail, hear live commentary about the area's geology and marine life from a marine biologist. Stop at the famous cave Algar de Benagil to take an Instagram-perfect picture.

Cruise down the Algarve coast and stop to visit hidden caves. At one of the beaches, dive off the boat and swim in the clear water.

Next, leave the coast behind and sail off into the Atlantic in search of dolphins. Get videos of these playful creatures jumping and swimming around the boat before returning to the mainland.
highlights: Breathe in the fresh salty air of the ocean as you cruise along the coast
Laugh at the playful dolphins' antics as they swim around and under the boat
Venture inside the hidden Benagil sea caves and see stunning rock formations
Swim in the refreshing, clear water at one of Algarve's beautiful beaches
Learn about the area's many sea creatures and geology from a marine biologist
goodToKnow: - Check-in must be done up to 30 minutes before the experience, at the 5emotionsalgarve counter N.6, in Portimão Marina;
- It is not necessary to print your ticket, but we will need to see the confirmation sent to your email and your identification for check-in;
- Entry to the caves is subject to prohibition by the Local Marine Police, due to poor sea conditions;
- Due to local regulations, the boat can only stay in the Benagil Caves for a few minutes, and is not allowed to disembark customers from the boat to the caves or beaches;
- The stop for a swim is only possible if the sea conditions allow it;
- Please let us know in advance if you need assistance with a wheelchair.
- There are no reserved seats. Passengers are seated on board by our crew to ensure maximum safety, comfort and satisfaction.

sampleReviews.text: Loved the entire experience. The marine biologists were amazing!
A nice tour – interesting! Lots of information – thank you very much! I would highly recommend it!!!

It was a wonderful tour with a lot of information and great guides. The fact that we could see orcas was absolutely amazing, and the additional information and explanations about the animals were also great. All in all, a wonderful experience. P.S. The fact that I was even allowed to charge my wheelchair saved my day. Otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to do anything else. Many, many thanks to the team.
Really great activity! Just pure joy watching the dolphins and the coasts
Super nice guides and a great experience. I can highly recommend it.

Fantastic trip and great fun from start to finish. The boat was fast, which made the journey along the coast really enjoyable, and the Benagil Caves were brilliant to see from the water. We were also lucky enough to see lots of dolphins, which was definitely one of the highlights. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and clearly knew her stuff, giving plenty of interesting information without making it feel like a lecture. Really well organised, great fun and definitely worth the money. I’d happily do it again and would highly recommend it.

The marine biologists on board were very knowledgeable. We were impressed by the number of languages they spoke fluently. The boat ride was fun and the caves were interesting but the highlight of the trip was seeing a pod of orcas. We really enjoyed the trip.
A wonderful excursion! Multilingual guides and the seats on the boat were incredibly comfortable (very rare!)

title: From Albufeira: Benagil Caves and Dolphins Guided Boat Tour - From $39
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Enjoy a 2 hour and 30 minute experience through the most emblematic Algarve caves and secret beaches, observe dolphins and have a unique day!

1. Catamaran - 2026 boat with capacity for 100 people, equipped with WC and bar on board, ideal for families and groups of friends.

sampleReviews.text: Beautiful views, and we were lucky enough to see dolphins! The crew was very professional and knowledgeable, and they shared many interesting stories and facts throughout the cruise. We really enjoyed the experience and would definitely recommend it!

Gabriel and his colleague gave us wonderful memories. We visited all the caves, each with its own story. Afterward, we went looking for dolphins—and, of course, we found them. The atmosphere throughout the entire cruise was fantastic
It's great!! We were able to see the dolphins and the Benagil Cave. I highly recommend it. This activity is worth the trip

What a fabulous way to spend an afternoon. Bruno, Tomas, Vivian and our captain were all excellent. Good company, energetic and knowledgeable. We managed to see dolphins, get into the caves and also have a little sea swim. Clean and modern boat, good facilities. But again the crew really topped it off.
Very well organized with the necessary humorous crew and sufficient explanation. Definitely recommended.

Excellent ! We saw a lot of beautiful caves, the coastline was wonderful! Our guide & captain were amazing !! We took the ripboat at 9 Am it was perfect, not a lot of boats so we didnt wait to see the caves. We had the chance to see dolphins too ! It was a beautiful experience, i totally recommand !
The on-board staff are really great; we had a great time.

Great activity, but be aware that the departure points are a bit far from the historic center of the city. Very good crew, friendly, and the party host had a good level of French. I thought seeing dolphins was a marketing ploy that wouldn't happen, but I was wrong. I am very happy to have seen dolphins. Pay attention to the weather before booking. If you are coming with children, be aware that the noise level on a boat is high due to the engines. Bar service is available, which is great. A very good souvenir and a price that I thought was very fair. The dolphin-watching boat needs to be large to go offshore, so it cannot get as close as possible to certain viewing points on the cliffs. I recommend the activity.

title: Benagil Cave & Sea Caves Guided Kayak Tour + Sunrise &Sunset - From $32
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Join a fully guided two hour kayak tour along the Benagil coastline and discover some of the Algarve’s most iconic sea caves, cliffs, and natural arches. Paddle in small groups of up to 12 people with a local guide from start to finish, with clear instructions, a safety briefing, and support throughout the experience.

Meet your team at an easy meeting point at Benagil Beach and get ready at our support base. Before you go on the water, you can use restrooms. A waterproof bag is included for items you want to keep with you during the tour. Lockers are available on site for valuables (payable locally).
We will fit your life jacket and make sure you are ready to go.

Once on the water, your guide leads the group along the coast, choosing the best route for the day and sharing tips and local insights. You will head towards the famous Benagil Cave and continue to the stunning rock formations and arches near Marinha Beach. The exact route and cave access depend on sea conditions and safety rules, always with your safety as the priority.

This experience is suitable for beginners who are comfortable in the water. Bring swimwear, sunscreen, and water, and arrive early for check in and preparation.
highlights: Fully guided kayak tour, small groups up to 12 people
Two hour experience along the Benagil coastline
See Benagil Cave and sea caves, sea conditions permitting
Easy meeting point, restrooms at base, lockers available on site
Safety briefing and equipment included, plus a waterproof bag
goodToKnow: We strongly recommend coming by taxi or Uber, as parking in Benagil is very limited, especially during the summer.

sampleReviews.text: The tour with Raul, our tour guide, was great! We had great experiences in the different caves, and his explanations were very informative. We highly recommend the tour.
5 stars. The guide, Afonso, was impeccable, and I loved the experience! I recommend it!

The activity was excellent. Our guide Afonso was super attentive, polite, and concerned about everyone's safety by not going out with too many people at the same time. He always checked access to the caves before telling us to go in, again prioritizing security, and he even scolded colleagues from other companies for having too few guides for too many people. I recommend doing the activity in the morning. The sea is calmer and the tide is lower, providing access to some caves that may not be accessible in the afternoon. After the grottos, we had around 20 minutes free and really enjoyed the scenery. I would do it a thousand times; it was awesome!

An exceptional experience. We saw wonderful places thanks to our guide, Rodrigo, who accompanied us and explained the various caves that make this unique place famous. Highly recommended!!! Thanks from Rosa and Nicholas

We did the activity in a group of 3 people and had Raul as our instructor. He was very fun and friendly, explained everything very carefully, and did his best to make the tour fun and safe. It was a really great experience, and we would definitely do it again! Thanks for the tour. We had a lot of fun! (Give me a ride next time!!🤣-Heloísa)
It was a truly amazing experience, and an incredible live guide! We loved it! Thank you very much, and especially thank you, David :)

We did the activity on August 12th at 8:30 AM. Incredibly fun, suitable for all ages. We saw several caves and beaches, including Benagil, both to the east and west of the starting point. If there is an option, it is better to do the activity early, since there is a lot of demand and the town parking lot fills up very quickly (we arrived at 7:30 AM and had breakfast there). We want to give a special mention to Gonçalo and David, our tour guides, and to Raúl, who gave us the directions before we set off. Thank you very much!
It was great to do this tour before the crowds arrived, and the guide, Raoul, was nice and caring. A really great tour.

title: Adventure: Secret Caves and Hidden Beaches Beyond Benagil, Max. 4 Kayaks - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Walk to a hidden beach to explore secret caves beyond Benagil by kayak, without crowds, at sunrise – perfect for enjoying the fantastic Algarve coast.
Explore one of the most spectacular areas of the Algarve coast from a hidden beach on an exclusive kayak experience departing from Praia das Fontainhas. Limited to just 4 kayaks per outing, this adventure was created for those looking for a more authentic and personalized exploration, ideal for adventurers and away from large groups.

After a short introduction and safety briefing, we will go down a small path, where we will depart from Praia das Fontainhas towards the impressive golden cliffs, secret caves, and hidden beaches that make this coast so special. Along the way, we will visit the famous Grotto of Benagil and explore other lesser-known caves and rock formations, accessible only by sea.

The small number of participants allows you to paddle at a leisurely pace, with more time to enjoy the scenery, take pictures, and discover places that many visitors never get to see. During the experience, your guide will share interesting facts about the coast, its geological formations, and local history.

This experience is ideal for travelers who value small groups, close contact with nature, and a more relaxed way to explore the Algarve coast. Ideal for those with an adventurous spirit!
highlights: Departure from Praia das Fontainhas
Group limited to 4 kayaks
Visit to the Benagil Cave and other hidden caves
Discover beaches only accessible by sea
More time for photos and exploration
includes: Exploration of the coast between Praia do Carvalho and Benagil
Visit to hidden caves and rock formations
Time for photos and stops along the way

sampleReviews.text: Great activity in a small group with a superb guide, very clear communication... book here so you don't end up in a "herd" of 10 canoes...

title: Lagos: Combo Dolphin and Benagil Tour with Marine Biologist - From $45
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
One trip, two Magic Experiences!
Dolphin Watching & Benagil Cave Tour with expert Marine Biologists — all in one incredible adventure!
Discover the very best of Lagos & Benagil in a single journey, guided by an outstanding team and aboard one of the safest and most advanced vessels on the water - Hurricane!!

Departing from the Marina de Lagos, this 2h30 experience will take you onto the Atlantic Ocean, to explore and search for one of six different species of wild Dolphins, thriving in their natural habitat, along the Algarve coast. Our experienced Marine Biologists are by your side to guide you through this awe-inspiring encounter with these majestic animals!

From there, you're adventure continues as you cruise along the dramatic coastline to visit Portugal’s most iconic sea cave — the world-famous Algar de Benagil — before enjoying breathtaking coastal views all the way back to Lagos Marina.

All of this takes place aboard our speedboat “Hurricane” — fast, modern, adaptable, and built with safety as a top priority. Hurricane is proudly dolphin-friendly, powered by twin Hydrojet Propulsion Systems that prevent harmful contact with marine life. By joining this tour, you’re actively supporting ocean conservation and wildlife protection.

Creating memories that will last you a lifetime!

Note: Dolphin watching is a search for wild animals in their natural environment. Our experienced team knows the main feeding areas and hotspots around Lagos, giving us an impressive ~97% success rate, but every encounter remains a unique and authentic experience.
Note - Please note that entry into the Benagil Caves is subject to weather and sea conditions. For safety reasons, we only enter the caves when conditions are suitable and safe.
highlights: Two magic experiences: Dolphin Watching and Benagil Cave in one trip
Experience the best with our expert Marine Biologists on board
Wild dolphins in their natural habitat, guided by Marine Biologists
Visit the iconic Algar de Benagil and Algarve’s dramatic coastline
Ride the fast, safe and dolphin-friendly speedboat Hurricane
goodToKnow: Please note, due to changing sea and weather conditions, trips can be cancelled or changed for safety reasons
Please note that entry into the Benagil Caves is subject to weather and sea conditions. For safety reasons, we only enter the caves when conditions are suitable and safe.
Dolphins are wild animals, our success rate of finding dolphins is 98%

title: From Lagos: Scenic Cruise to the Benagil and Carvoeiro Caves - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Explore the Algarve shoreline on this cruise from Lagos to the Benagil and Carvoeiro caves. Travel at high speeds in a new 18-seater rigid inflatable boat with comfortable padded benches. Capture pictures of the stunning Algar de Benagil cave.

description:
Experience the famous Benagil Cave from Vilamoura on a custom-built cave-entry boat designed to get you closer to the Algarve’s most spectacular sea caves. Unlike many larger, overcrowded boats that can only pass by the cave entrances, our boat is specially suited for entering selected caves safely when sea and weather conditions allow.

Depart from Vilamoura Marina and cruise west along one of the most beautiful stretches of coastline in Portugal. Sit back in your own guaranteed individual seat and enjoy a more comfortable, organised, and personal experience from start to finish. There is no standing in a crowded space or fighting for a view — every guest has their own seat, giving you a better way to enjoy the cliffs, caves, beaches, and photo opportunities along the route.

Your experienced skipper will guide you along the Algarve coastline toward Benagil, passing golden cliffs, hidden beaches, natural arches, rock formations, and smaller sea caves along the way. The route is filled with incredible scenery, and your crew will share local knowledge while choosing the best and safest places to visit depending on the sea conditions on the day.

The highlight of the tour is the world-famous Benagil Cave, one of Portugal’s most iconic natural landmarks. When conditions allow, the boat will enter the cave so you can admire its dramatic dome, natural skylight, ocean entrance, and unique rock formations from inside the cave itself. This gives you a much more memorable view than simply passing outside on a larger boat.

During the journey, your crew will also keep watch for wild dolphins. Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed because they are free animals in their natural habitat, but the Algarve coast is known for regular encounters with common and bottlenose dolphins.

This tour is ideal for couples, families, friends, and anyone wanting a comfortable Benagil Cave boat trip from Vilamoura with cave entry, guaranteed seating, and a professional local crew. title: Benagil, Marinha & Albandeira Kayak - Max 6 Pax & 4K Photos - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Discover the most complete Benagil kayak tour. Explore Benagil Cave, Praia da Marinha and Albandeira in groups of up to 6 guests. Enjoy a relaxed pace with 4K GoPro Hero 12 photos, local guides, snacks and water included.

Unlike many tours that focus only on Benagil Cave, our route also explores the spectacular coastline of Marinha and Albandeira. With a maximum of 6 guests per guide, there's more time to explore, ask questions and enjoy each stop without feeling rushed.

Your guide will capture 4K GoPro Hero 12 photos throughout the tour, so you can enjoy the experience without worrying about your phone.

Meet us at the beach and get ready for the ultimate kayak adventure along the Algarve coast. We'll provide all the equipment you need: life jacket, paddle, waterproof bag, water and a snack.

After a short safety briefing and kayaking instruction, you’ll launch from the shore and start paddling with our group, always guided by our local guide (and kayak instructors). Whether it’s your first time or you’ve kayaked before, you’ll feel safe, supported and confident from start to finish.

As we glide along the coastline, you’ll discover the area’s most impressive cliffs, rock formations and hidden sea passages, while learning about the local history, nature and marine life. Along the way, we’ll explore caves, tunnels and secret spots that make this coast one of the most beautiful in Europe.

Visit the famous Benagil Cave, one of the world's largest sea caves and Algarve's most iconic natural landmark.

The perfect way to discover Algarve's spectacular coastline and create memories that last long after your holiday.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

- This activity starts and ends at Albandeira Beach.

- Suitable for both beginners and experienced kayakers.

- If your group has more than 6 people you can contact us and we'll arrange it for you.

- We use double and single kayaks.
- Single kayaks are usually reserved for the guides, but if you’d like one, let us know and we’ll do our best to arrange it (subject to availability and sea conditions).
- Some of our double kayaks can be converted into a triple kayak according to the height and weight of the participants.

- Due to local rules, it is not allowed to step onto the sand inside Benagil Cave. We can enter the cave, but we must stay in the water.

- We may stop inside other caves, but this depends on ocean conditions and safety. We always aim to enter as many as possible when conditions allow.

- If stopping inside caves isn’t possible, we can often stop at hidden beaches only accessible from the sea.

- This is a very popular area, so you may see other groups and boats during the tour. For a quieter experience, we recommend booking early morning (7:00 or 8:00) or afternoon (after 13:00).

- If you join an early morning or late afternoon tour, we recommend bringing a light windbreaker, as the ocean breeze can feel cool when wet.

goodToKnow: Kayaking requires a moderate level of fitness. Although our kayaks are tandem, allowing you to share the experience with a partner, we recommend that participants are reasonably active to ensure a comfortable and enjoyable tour.

On windy days, it can feel quite cold out on the ocean, especially when you are wet. This is particularly noticeable during early morning or late afternoon tours. If you tend to get cold easily, we recommend bringing a lightweight rain jacket or windbreaker.

Being offshore can be challenging for some people, but we’ll do our best to make the experience as enjoyable and memorable as possible. Explore the best of southern Portugal in one amazing day!

Start with a private hotel pickup for exclusive tours, or meet the small group at Hard Rock Cafe in Lisbon. Then enjoy a comfortable ride in an air-conditioned vehicle to the beautiful Algarve region.

Your first stop is Lagos, a town full of history. It started as a Moorish town in the 8th century, became important during the 15th-century Age of Discoveries, and had Europe’s first slave market in 1444. Visit the Slave Market Museum, walk the old streets, and enjoy the lively marina.

Next, relax on two famous beaches: Praia Dona Ana and Praia do Camilo. Then visit Ponta da Piedade, where tall cliffs and amazing rock formations meet the ocean.

After that, head to the fishing village of Carvoeiro. Walk through the natural rock paths at Algar Seco and see the famous Boneca Cave, which has two window-like openings looking out to the sea.

The last stop is the stunning Benagil Sea Cave, formed over millions of years. If the weather is good, take a boat ride inside this famous cave, or enjoy the view from above.

After a full day of history, nature, and beautiful views, relax on the drive back to Lisbon.

This tour is perfect for anyone who wants to see history, beaches, and amazing caves—all in one day!

Explore the iconic Benagil Caves and the Algarve’s stunning Golden Coast aboard our sustainable electric catamaran, enjoying a more comfortable, quiet and eco-friendly way to discover this extraordinary coastline.

This relaxing boat journey takes you from Portimão Marina along the coast, where golden cliffs, hidden coves, wild beaches and remarkable rock formations create one of the most breathtaking landscapes in the Algarve. Along the way, we enter several caves, including Smugglers Cave, Pirate Cave, Guardian Cave, Alfanzina Cave and the world-famous Benagil Cave, while also passing other extraordinary rock formations shaped by the sea over time. You will also pass the picturesque village of Carvoeiro and the striking rock formations of Algar Seco.

As the boat makes its way to the Benagil Caves, our crew shares stories and insights about the coastline, offering a genuine local perspective in English and Portuguese.

Our electric catamaran glides smoothly across the water, with no engine noise, no smell of fuel and zero emissions, allowing you to enjoy the ocean in a calm and relaxing atmosphere.

Designed for superior comfort and small groups, the boat features lounge-style seating, an onboard bar with drinks and snacks, a sun deck and an onboard toilet for extra comfort. Passengers can move around freely on board and do not need to wear uncomfortable lifejackets throughout the tour.

On the way back, enjoy music on board while taking in the coastline from a different perspective.

During the Summer daytime tours, there is also time for a refreshing swim stop, so do not forget your towel and swimsuit.

title: Top Rated From Faro: Benagil, Marinha, 7 Valleys, Algar Seco - From $67
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Embark into the paradise of the Algarve Coast.

Departing from Faro in a comfortable van equipped with air conditioning and karaoke microphone, enjoy a peaceful and exciting journey to the municipality of Lagoa, where the scenery of this adventure awaits.

The first stop is Benagil, home to one of the most famous caves in the world, the extraordinary Algar de Benagil or Benagil Cave. The lush views of the cliffs, beach, and caves of the area will make an invitation to happiness.

We will start our adventure taking a short walk to Benagil's viewpoint, passing through a small fishing village. Immerse yourself in the culture and history of the area. After enjoying the view from the viewpoint, we will descend to visit Benagil Beach and prepare for HIKING on the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail.

During the hike between Benagil and Praia da Marinha along the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail, your guide will inform you about interesting facts and aspects about the fauna, flora and geology of the region. The views from the top of Benagil Cave, Praia da Corredoura, The Gigante, Praia da Mesquita and Praia da Marinha will leave you breathless. You will visit incredible sites such as Elephant Rock, the Mini Canyon and the Secret Heart of the Seven Valleys.

After the hike, you will have free time to refresh and relax at one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, Marinha Beach. The crystal-clear waters and golden sands will make a brilliant invitation to explore this beauty. Ask your guide about the secret spots! The Lunch break takes place during free time (read the recommendations in the "Know Before You Go" section).

At Algar Seco, the galleries and caves carved into the limestone rock will amaze you. The legends about this natural monument will take you on a journey through the beginnings of Portugal. The fossils embedded in the rocky coast will convince you that nature is sovereign.

To finish, a cliff jump into the deep waters of the North Atlantic will provide a farewell full of adrenaline and excitement.

When you return to Faro, you will have the feeling of having lived in a movie.

title: Algarve: The Seven Wonders of the Benagil Coast E-Bike Tour - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
E-Bike Tour “The Seven Wonders of the Coast: From Albandeira to Algar Seco”

Is a popular guided cycling experience along one of Portugal’s most scenic coastal routes.

Get ready for an epic two-wheeled adventure! This exclusive Xplorebenagil route takes you along the Algarve’s most breathtaking cliffs. Starting from our meeting point, we’ve designed a journey that blends the adrenaline of cycling with the serene beauty of the ocean.

From the natural rock arch at Albandeira Beach to the famous rocky “windows” of Algar Seco, you’ll pass through jaw-dropping viewpoints, including the iconic aerial view of Benagil Cave and the crystal-clear waters of Marinha Beach. It’s the perfect mix of sport, nature, and the best “postcard-perfect” photos you’ll take home from this trip.

Our Itinerary:

Meeting Point (Departure): We begin our adventure at the Xplorebenagil base. After a brief safety briefing and bike fitting, we start pedaling toward the coastline.

Albandeira Beach: Our first major stop is one of the region’s most peaceful gems. Famous for its impressive natural rock arch that plunges into the sea, it’s the perfect setting for the first photos.

Marinha Beach Viewpoint: We ride to one of Portugal’s icons. Considered one of the 10 most beautiful beaches in Europe, we stop at the top of the cliff to admire its unique rock formations (like the famous “M Rock,” or “Cathedral”) and its turquoise-blue waters.

Benagil Cave (Top View): A truly exclusive perspective. Instead of going into the water, we head to the top of the cliff to look down through the famous “eye” (the sinkhole/opening) of the cave, taking in the grandeur of this natural cathedral from above.

Carvalho Beach: We continue on to the mysterious “Smugglers’ Beach.” Known for access via a hand-carved tunnel through the rock, it’s a stunning, sheltered bay.

Alfanzina Lighthouse: A historic landmark in the landscape. Built on a rocky promontory, this lighthouse has guided sailors since 1920 and offers an unobstructed panoramic view over the Atlantic horizon.

Vale Centeanes Beach: We make a short stop to take in this beach nestled between high cliffs, enjoying the valley view before continuing to the final point along the coast.

Algar Seco (Carvoeiro): The geological highlight of our tour. Explore this maze of rock formations carved by wind and sea, peek through natural “windows,” and discover the famous “Boneca” formation.

Return to the Meeting Point: After enjoying Algar Seco’s views, we begin the ride back to our base.

**Details of the tour**

The tour is limited to 10 people

**What to bring for the E-Bike tour**

• Bring water
• Comfortable clothing
• Energy bar or fruit
• Sunscreen and sunglasses

**Languages offered in the activity**

English, Portuguese, Spanish, French (optional)

**Important to Know**

Always arrive at the meeting point 10 minutes before the beginning of the tour.
The day, time, and duration of the tour may change depending on the weather conditions.

title: Lisbon: Day Trip To Algarve, Benagil Cave, Carvoeiro & Lagos - From $103

description:
Discover the Algarve on a day trip from Lisbon. Visit the famous Benagil Cave, Benagil Beach, admire the cliffs of Algar Seco - Carvoeiro, and explore Lagos with stops at Praia Dona Ana / Praia do Camilo, & Ponta da Piedade. the southernmost part of Portugal.

Your journey begins with a stop at the famous Benagil Cave viewpoint, where you can admire the stunning sea cave from above - Land View of Benagil Cave: Take a short walk from the parking area to a cliff-top viewpoint overlooking the cave’s iconic skylight.
While access inside the cave is restricted!
Sea View of Benagil Cave: Choose the optional boat tour (extra cost) from Benagil or Portimão for an up-close view of Benagil Cave’s stunning interior from the sea.

Continue to Algar Seco, a spectacular coastal area known for its dramatic cliffs, hidden grottoes, and panoramic ocean views. Walk along scenic pathways and discover the enchanting Boneca Cave, also known as “The Doll’s Cave.”

In Lagos, enjoy free time to relax, explore, or swim in the crystal-clear waters. Take in the beauty of the Algarve coastline at Praia Dona Ana, Praia do Camilo, & the iconic cliffs of Ponta da Piedade.

Here are the 2 itinerary for you -

Itinerary 1: Algarve Tour Without Boat Ride.
• Lisbon → Algarve: approximately 2h45m drive
• First stop: Benagil — land view of Benagil Cave and pass by Benagil Beach
• 15 min drive
• Second stop: Algar Seco in Carvoeiro, including a visit to Boneca Cave
• Free time for lunch in Carvoeiro, or continue the tour
• 40 min drive
• Final stop: Lagos — free time for lunch, enjoy the beach, boardwalk, scenic cliffs, and time to explore. Swimming (July ~ October), but you can still enjoy the beach and get your feet wet
• Return to Lisbon from Lagos: approximately 3h drive.

Itinerary 2: Algarve Tour With Boat Ride.
• Lisbon → Algarve: approximately 2h30m drive
• First stop: Algar Seco in Carvoeiro, including a visit to Boneca Cave
• Continue with a 25 min drive
• Second stop: Portimão Cruise Port
Note: Optional Boat ride to Benagil cave — Extra cost, with others supplier, your guide will assist with arrangements. Prices - depending on the duration & route you choose, 30 ~ 90 minutes boat ride along the Algarve coastline, visiting 5+ caves including sea view of Benagil Cave, pass by Benagil Beach. It's depend on sea conditions and availability. On some days, due to restrictions from the maritime police, boats may not be allowed to enter the cave and will instead provide coastal views only.
• Free time for lunch in Portimão, or continue the tour
• 35 min drive
• Final stop: Lagos — free time for lunch, enjoy the beach, boardwalk, scenic cliffs, and time to explore. Swimming is not recommended (timing) but you can still enjoy the beach and get your feet wet
• Return to Lisbon from Lagos: approximately 3h drive.

After a memorable day exploring the Algarve, sit back and enjoy the scenic drive back to Lisbon in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle.

title: Lagoa: Small-group Dolphins & Benagil Caves with Biologist - From $69
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Operated by a dedicated family-run team, this experience is built on strong values: quality over quantity, safety, environmental responsibility, and authentic human connection. From the moment you arrive, and for the following 3 hours, you’ll feel welcomed into a relaxed and friendly atmosphere where every guest matters.
Expect a small and intimate group, maximum of just 17 guests, including a personal interaction with your guides. Experience a respectful marine wildlife approach and up-close encounters from a comfortable 9-meter RIB boat, with a mix of bench and jockey seats, designed for ocean navigation with both speed and safety.

Departure from Parchal, in front of a restaurant with a beautiful river view - your journey begins at the meeting point sign at the pier with check-in and life jacket fitting, followed by boarding the vessel. Before departure, you’ll receive a comprehensive safety and wildlife briefing.

The tour starts slowly, moving along the Arade River, a place of calm and history, passing through Portimão and Ferragudo into the thrill of the ocean!

Explore the Lagoa coastline: see dramatic cliffs, hidden beaches, and extraordinary rock formations shaped over millions of years. The highlight is entering the world-famous Benagil Cave. Your biologist guide will share fascinating insights into the region’s geology, history, and natural processes, enriching what you see with deeper understanding.

Heading offshore, you’ll search for dolphins and other marine species. With a 98% sighting success rate, encounters are highly likely, but never guaranteed. Animals are always approached ethically - this means no chasing or disturbing wildlife.

Accompanied by Ana, a caring biologist, and Pedro, the experienced captain and passionate diving instructor, every sighting feels meaningful: it´s never rushed or intrusive, respecting each species's behaviour! Through live interpretation, you’ll gain insight into dolphin behavior, communication, and the marine ecosystem. Questions are encouraged, creating a dynamic and engaging experience.

This experience goes beyond tourism. Data is collected during each trip and shared with research and conservation organizations, contributing to the ongoing understanding and protection of marine ecosystems. By joining, you become part of a broader effort to respect and preserve ocean life.

After the tour, you will get underwater videos of the wildlife, when Ocean conditions permit safe filming.
Whether you’re traveling solo, as a couple, or with family, this experience is inclusive and welcoming to all.

Note: The route of the tour is flexible and adapted in real time - Depending on sea conditions and wildlife activity, the captain will decide whether to begin offshore in search of dolphins or along the coastline exploring caves. This is to ensure the best possible experience on every trip.

title: From Lisbon: Algarve, Benagil Sea Cave & Lagos Full-Day Tour - 2026 (Verified Reviews)

description:
Discover the Algarve on a day trip from Lisbon. Visit the famous Benagil Cave, Benagil Beach, admire the cliffs of Algar Seco - Carvoeiro, and explore Lagos with stops at Praia Dona Ana / Praia do Camilo, & Ponta da Piedade. the southernmost part of Portugal.

Your journey begins with a stop at the famous Benagil Cave viewpoint, where you can admire the stunning sea cave from above - Land View of Benagil Cave: Take a short walk from the parking area to a cliff-top viewpoint overlooking the cave’s iconic skylight.
While access inside the cave is restricted!
Sea View of Benagil Cave: Choose the optional boat tour (extra cost) from Benagil or Portimão for an up-close view of Benagil Cave’s stunning interior from the sea.

Continue to Algar Seco, a spectacular coastal area known for its dramatic cliffs, hidden grottoes, and panoramic ocean views. Walk along scenic pathways and discover the enchanting Boneca Cave, also known as “The Doll’s Cave.”

In Lagos, enjoy free time to relax, explore, or swim in the crystal-clear waters. Take in the beauty of the Algarve coastline at Praia Dona Ana, Praia do Camilo, & the iconic cliffs of Ponta da Piedade.

Here are the 2 itinerary for you -

Itinerary 1: Algarve Tour Without Boat Ride.
• Lisbon → Algarve: approximately 2h45m drive
• First stop: Benagil — land view of Benagil Cave and pass by Benagil Beach
• 15 min drive
• Second stop: Algar Seco in Carvoeiro, including a visit to Boneca Cave
• Free time for lunch in Carvoeiro, or continue the tour
• 40 min drive
• Final stop: Lagos — free time for lunch, enjoy the beach, boardwalk, scenic cliffs, and time to explore. Swimming (July ~ October), but you can still enjoy the beach and get your feet wet
• Return to Lisbon from Lagos: approximately 3h drive.

Itinerary 2: Algarve Tour With Boat Ride.
• Lisbon → Algarve: approximately 2h30m drive
• First stop: Algar Seco in Carvoeiro, including a visit to Boneca Cave
• Continue with a 25 min drive
• Second stop: Portimão Cruise Port
Note: Optional Boat ride to Benagil cave — Extra cost, with others supplier, your guide will assist with arrangements. Prices - depending on the duration & route you choose, 30 ~ 90 minutes boat ride along the Algarve coastline, visiting 5+ caves including sea view of Benagil Cave, pass by Benagil Beach. It's depend on sea conditions and availability. On some days, due to restrictions from the maritime police, boats may not be allowed to enter the cave and will instead provide coastal views only.
• Free time for lunch in Portimão, or continue the tour
• 35 min drive
• Final stop: Lagos — free time for lunch, enjoy the beach, boardwalk, scenic cliffs, and time to explore. Swimming is not recommended (timing) but you can still enjoy the beach and get your feet wet
• Return to Lisbon from Lagos: approximately 3h drive.

After a memorable day exploring the Algarve, sit back and enjoy the scenic drive back to Lisbon in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle.

Embark on a captivating sunrise journey along Portimão's stunning coastline, starting at your Clube Naval. The boat sets sail, welcoming passengers with the sea breeze and the promise of unforgettable adventures.

The first stop is the imposing Torre da Lapa, a historic monument that was part of the defensive structure of the Algarve coast. As we appreciate the architecture and hear fascinating stories about its past, we are enveloped by the unique atmosphere of this place steeped in history.

The journey continues towards the Gruta do Contrabando, where the magic of the ocean reveals hidden secrets. Navigating the crystal-clear waters, the cave reveals intriguing rock formations, while the skipper shares stories of the smugglers and sailors who brought these waters to life.

Following the coastline, visitors are treated to the additional beauty of the Gruta do Presidente, with its impressive rock formations. Shortly afterwards, the Alfanzina Lighthouse comes into view, standing like a majestic guardian of the coastline, providing the sight of a postcard you're sure to treasure.

The highlight of the tour is the stunning Gruta do Paraíso, hailed as the new jewel of the region. title: Guided Hiking Tour on the Trail of the Seven Hanging Valleys - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Guided hiking along the best coast in the Algarve. (Sete Vales Suspensos Trail)


Praia da Marinha, considered one of the 100 best in the world by the Michelin guide.

Transport during the activity included on the Price (return transfer service)
Location: coastal strip between Praia da Marinha and Vale Centeanes
Type: pedestrian
Circular route: no
Distance: 6 km
Average duration: 3 hours
Capacity: limited to 12 people

Route: starting at Praia da Marinha and ending at Praia de Vale Centeanes
Type of path: dirt and somewhat rocky paths
This route goes down and up ravines that almost always end above sea level – the hanging valleys. In the distant past, each hanging valley was associated with the mouth of a river, owing its formation to a rapid retreat of the coastline not accompanied by the notch of the waterline.

The action of fresh and salty waters results in the formation of a patterned pattern on the coast, known as the karst landscape, with a remarkable diversity of geoforms that can be observed at Praia da Marinha: arches, caves, sinkholes and shallows.
Benagil Beach appears associated with the mouth of a torrential river that carved a narrow gully in the cliff. This beach was home to a fishing community dedicated to artisanal arts; Nowadays, boats are mainly used to visit sea caves.

At Praia do Carvalho, the sand is accessed through a tunnel excavated in the soft Miocene limestone, where you can observe the profusion of sea shells aggregated in the rock matrix. In the Mediterranean coastal scrub, you can find the dwarf palm tree, the only European palm tree, and you can see the black-headed warbler, a small bird typical of the region.

The dense green of the Mediterranean vegetation is followed by a landscape with lunar characteristics, where clear and bare rock dominates. Ancient legends are told about this large rock, Leixão do Ladrão, such as that of the Moorish princess who mourns the death of her lover, creating with her tears the typical lacework of the limestone rock.

Around the Alfanzina Lighthouse, a forest of Aleppo pine grows, one of the few trees that colonizes these stony and arid lands. Here, the pine forests function as ecological islands for tits, blackbirds or Galician owls. The dense vegetation favors mammals such as rabbits, pythons and foxes.

title: Benagil Cave Open Speedboat Tour & Dolphin Search - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Discover the famous Benagil Cave on an exciting open speedboat tour along the Algarve coastline. Travel on a custom-built boat designed for cave visits, comfort, and great sea views, with individual seating for every guest.

Depart from Vilamoura and enjoy a refreshing speedboat ride along one of the most beautiful stretches of coastline in Portugal. Feel the sea breeze as you cruise past golden cliffs, hidden beaches, natural arches, rock formations, and impressive sea caves on the way to Benagil.

Unlike larger and more crowded boats, this open speedboat offers a more practical and personal experience. Each guest has their own individual seat, giving you more comfort, better visibility, and a safer way to enjoy the ride, caves, and coastline.

The highlight of the tour is the world-famous Benagil Cave, one of the Algarve’s most photographed natural landmarks. When ocean and safety conditions allow, your skipper will enter selected caves so you can admire the rock formations, natural light, and dramatic scenery from inside the cave itself.

This tour is ideal for visitors who want a fun and scenic Algarve boat trip with a mix of speed, sightseeing, cave exploration, and unforgettable photo opportunities. Bring your camera, as the Benagil Cave and surrounding coastline are some of the best places in the Algarve for holiday photos.

During the trip, your crew will also keep watch for wild dolphins. Sightings cannot be guaranteed because dolphins are free animals in their natural habitat, but the Algarve coastline is known for regular encounters with common and bottlenose dolphins.

Whether you are visiting as a couple, family, or group of friends, this open speedboat tour is a fantastic way to experience Benagil Cave, Algarve sea caves, coastal views, and the possibility of dolphins in one exciting trip.
highlights: Enter Benagil caves on a custom-built open speedboat
Enjoy individual seating for a safer and more comfortable ride
Take unforgettable photos inside Benagil Cave when conditions allow

description:
Embark on an extraordinary coastal expedition, departing from Lisbon with a private hotel pickup, and immerse yourself in the unparalleled beauty of the Algarve region, renowned for its dramatic landscapes and captivating vistas. This journey offers an exquisite blend of nature, adventure, and relaxation, visiting some of southern Portugal's most iconic and breathtaking landmarks.

Your first destination is the world-famous Benagil Cave, a mesmerizing sea cavern that has captured the imagination of travelers from around the globe. While access inside the cave is no longer permitted for safety reasons, you will be escorted to a vantage point offering a panoramic view of the cavern’s colossal arches and the surrounding coastline. For those seeking a more intimate experience, a boat ride (available at an additional cost, subject to favorable sea conditions) allows a closer encounter with this natural wonder.

Next, delve into the captivating Algar Seco area, where dramatic limestone formations and hidden grottoes await discovery. Wander along the coastal trails, taking in awe-inspiring views of the ocean and cliffs, and visit the intriguing Boneca Cave, often referred to as "The Doll's Cave" due to its striking resemblance to a face. This is a haven for nature lovers, offering a serene escape into an unspoiled landscape.

Continue your journey to Praia Dona Ana and Marinha Beach, two of the Algarve’s most enchanting beaches, celebrated for their golden sands, crystal-clear waters, and imposing cliffs. These idyllic locations invite relaxation, whether you choose to bask in the sun, swim in the azure waters, or simply absorb the tranquil surroundings.

For those with a sense of adventure, the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail is an unmissable experience. This stunning coastal path offers dramatic vistas over the rugged cliffs and pristine coves below, creating the perfect environment for exploration and discovery.

Your journey culminates with some leisure time in Lagos, a historic town rich in culture and charm. Afterward, you will return to Lisbon, enjoying the scenic drive back while reflecting on the day’s unforgettable sights and experiences.

title: Lagoa: Dolphins Expedition with biologist guide on board - From $69
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Experience an authentic and responsible dolphin watching boat tour led by a seasoned captain and dedicated biologists who share a profound love for nature and marine life. Be ready for an adventure that combines education, exploration, and the magic of witnessing dolphins in their natural habitat.

Departing from Parchal in Lagoa, you will venture into the open sea in search of these highly intelligent ocean inhabitants and celebrate the wild nature that we all must preserve.
The tour lasts approximately 3 hours, depending on the distance and location of the groups of dolphins. The route we take is guided by their whereabouts, ensuring the best chance and quality of sightings.

The most commonly observed species are Common Dolphin (Delphinus delphis) and Bottlenose Dolphin (Tursiops truncatus). But, Algarve waters teem with biodiversity and you may spot incredible seabirds, jellyfish, and occasionally sharks, whales, or turtles.

Our enthusiastic and knowledgeable guides are committed to offering valuable insights into the unique marine ecosystem of the Algarve. Believing that education is vital to conservation, we continuously expand our expertise to provide meaningful information about marine wildlife and its preservation.

The magic of observing dolphins and other marine creatures in their natural environment is thrilling and indescribable. However, it's important to understand that these encounters are with unpredictable wild animals that roam freely in the Atlantic Ocean. Observing them happens in the wild, where sea conditions, weather, and other natural factors cannot be controlled and may affect visibility and the likelihood of sightings. Dolphins may sometimes be farther away, less active, or unsocial, but with great team effort and expertise, we have a remarkable 98% success rate in sightings.

Be an adventurous spirit and come prepared for the open sea - Bring weather-appropriate clothing, such as a windbreaker or warm jumper, as offshore conditions can vary significantly from inshore weather.

Our ethical approach to dolphin observation ensures minimal impact on the animals and their ecosystem. By adhering to local legislation and a strict code of conduct, we promote harmonious coexistence and contribute to the long-term protection of marine life. Join us for an adventure that will be the best day of your holiday.
highlights: Experience unforgettable moments with wild dolphins in their natural habitat
Contribute to a responsible, conscious & certified dolphin watching activity
Gain unique insights from passionate biologists & a seasoned captain
Discover Algarve's vibrant marine life, and occasional shark, whale, or turtle.
Enjoy an authentic, unpredictable & unforgettable 3hours Atlantic Ocean safari

We are fully licensed (AOC/27/2023) and trained for a responsible Cetaceans observation. We follow local legislation & code of conduct to ensure that our activity has the least possible impact, preserving the well-being of dolphins and the integrity of the ecosystem. Wild dolphin can't be summoned or controlled in nature, but we have 98% success rate in sightings.
Pet Friendly - Our mascot comes on board on most tours. If you have any objections, or want to bring a pet, please contact us.

description:
Discover the stunning beauty of southern Portugal on this Algarve day trip from Lisbon, featuring a Benagil Cave boat tour and visits to the region’s most iconic coastal locations.

Your journey begins with a comfortable drive from Lisbon to Portimão, where you’ll board a boat to explore the world-famous Benagil Cave. Cruise along the coastline, discover hidden caves, and admire the cave’s natural skylight (boat tour included, weather permitting).

Continue to Carvoeiro to visit the impressive rock formations of Algar Seco. Walk along scenic paths, explore natural tunnels, and enjoy breathtaking ocean views.

Next, head to Lagos, one of the Algarve’s most picturesque towns. Visit the famous Ponta da Piedade, known for its dramatic cliffs, sea arches, and panoramic viewpoints.

You’ll also stop at some of the Algarve’s most beautiful beaches, including Praia do Camilo and Praia Dona Ana, perfect for photos and relaxing by the sea.

This experience is ideal for travelers who want to explore the Algarve’s highlights in one day, combining nature, scenic landscapes, and a comfortable journey with a knowledgeable local guide. Flexible options are available to suit different travel styles.

title: Lisbon: Explore the Algarve Coast & Benagil Cave by Boat. - 2026 (Verified Reviews)

description:
Escape the city and discover the breathtaking coastline of southern Portugal on this unforgettable full-day Algarve tour from Lisbon. Whether you choose a Private tour or join a small group, you'll travel in comfort aboard a premium air-conditioned car or a luxurious van, accompanied by an knowledgeable English-speaking Driver and guide who will share fascinating stories, local history, and insider tips throughout the journey.

* Your first destination is the stunning ALGAR SECO.

one of the Algarve's most impressive coastal rock formations. Spend approximately 30 minutes exploring its dramatic limestone cliffs, natural pools, caves, and breathtaking viewpoints overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. This is the perfect place to capture unforgettable photographs and admire the unique geological beauty shaped by centuries of wind and waves.

* Portimão & BENAGIL CAVE Boat Tour

Next, continue to Portimão Marina, where you'll embark on one of the highlights of the day—an exciting boat tour to the world-famous Benagil Cave.

Cruise along the spectacular Algarve coastline while discovering 16 additional sea caves, hidden beaches, impressive rock formations, and natural arches that can only be appreciated from the water. Your experienced boat crew will safely navigate through the coastline while explaining the fascinating history and geology of this remarkable region.

The iconic Benagil Cave, illuminated by its famous natural skylight, is considered one of Europe's most beautiful sea caves and is an absolute must-see during any visit to Portugal.

Please note: The boat tour is operated by licensed local partners and is subject to weather and sea conditions.

* Explore the Historic Town of LAGOS.

After your coastal adventure, continue to the charming town of LAGOS, one of the Algarve's most historic and vibrant destinations.

Enjoy free time for a relaxing lunch break, where you can choose from a variety of excellent local restaurants serving fresh seafood, traditional Portuguese cuisine or international dishes.

Following lunch, visit the spectacular Ponta da Piedade, famous for its golden limestone cliffs, turquoise waters, sea arches, and panoramic viewpoints. Considered one of Portugal's most photographed natural landmarks, it offers incredible scenery in every direction.

Your final stop is the beautiful Praia do Camilo, a postcard-perfect beach reached by its famous wooden staircase. Surrounded by dramatic cliffs and crystal-clear waters, it's one of the Algarve's most iconic beaches.

After a memorable day exploring the Algarve, you'll depart Lagos at around 5:00 PM and begin the comfortable journey back to Lisbon. Relax in your air-conditioned vehicle while enjoying the scenic drive through southern Portugal. You'll arrive back in Lisbon at approximately 8:00 PM, where you'll be dropped off at your hotel or preferred location, bringing your unforgettable 10–12 hour Algarve adventure to a perfect end.

cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Be dazzled by several paradise beaches along the Algarve coast and if you are lucky you can see schools of dolphins along the way. This area of the coast is referred to as the Barlavento region, where placid warm waters and golden sand are framed by natural sculptures carved out of the cliff. Caves and subterranean caves, caused by erosion, sometimes unite these beaches and provide excellent sites for explorations. One of these sites are the caves of Benagil, which are among the ten natural wonders of the world.

At Marinha beach, you can see caves, subterranean canals, and natural arches. The cliffs are limestone with fractured and fissured tones, which exhibit a remarkable diversity of curious rocky patterns including arches, grottos, leixões, and algares. There are a diversity of marine habitats that house colorful hedgehogs, anemones, octopuses, cuttlefish, and seahorses. This beach is considered one of the hundred most beautiful in the world.

It’s a perfect spot for sunbathing, a short swim, or capturing postcard-worthy photos. As you explore the Benagil Cave. While venturing inside is no longer possible (you can opt for a boat ride at extra cost under good sea conditions), be led to a jaw-dropping viewpoint from which you can gaze in awe at the colossal sea cavern which is known for the opening in its top where light streams thorugh.

Enjoy a scenic boat tour featuring Algarve’s coastal beauty—dramatic cliffs, sea arches, hidden beaches & landmarks like Fort of Santa Catarina and the famous Benagil Cave.

Delve into the extraordinary, the Algar Seco, for a chance to explore coastal trails and pathways that wind their way through this picturesque landscape. See Boneca Cave which is often referred to as "The Doll's Cave," a captivating sea cave situated within the Algar Seco area.

title: Lisbon: Benagil Cave, 7 Hanging Valleys, & Lagos Marina - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Depart from Lisbon in a comfortable car equipped with air conditioning and enjoy a peaceful journey to the municipality of Lagoa.

Begin with a short walk to Benagil's viewpoint, passing through a small fishing village. Immerse yourself in the culture and history of the area. After enjoying the view from the viewpoint, descend to visit Benagil Beach and prepare for a hike on the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail.

During the hike between Benagil and Praia da Marinha along the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail, learn about interesting facts and aspects about the fauna, flora, and geology of the region. The views from the top of Benagil Cave, Praia da Corredoura, The Gigante, Praia da Mesquita, and Praia da Marinha will leave you breathless. Visit incredible sites such as Elephant Rock, the Mini Canyon, and the Secret Heart of the Seven Valleys.

After the hike, have free time to refresh and relax at one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, Marinha Beach. The crystal-clear waters and golden sands will make a brilliant invitation to explore this beauty. Ask your guide about the secret spots. Enjoy a lunch break during your free time.

At Algar Seco, the galleries and caves carved into the limestone rock will amaze you. The legends about this natural monument will take you on a journey through the beginnings of Portugal. The fossils embedded in the rocky coast will convince you that nature is sovereign.

Thereafter, visit Ponta da Piedade at Lagos. This dramatic headland features golden limestone cliffs sculpted by wind and sea into impressive arches, sea stacks, and grottoes that create a breathtaking coastal landscape. Admire panoramic views from the clifftop boardwalks or descend the stairway near the lighthouse for a closer look at the rock formations below.

Conclude your unforgettable coastal adventure with a visit to the Lagos Marina and Market, where you can stroll among charming boats, enjoy a refreshing drink, and browse local crafts before your return journey.

title: Seven Hanging Valleys - From $58
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Explore a stunning walking route with a landscape of cliffs and sinkholes in the Lagoa region. This is a popular coastal hiking route in the Algarve region, and stretches along the stunning cliffs between the beaches of Praia da Marinha and Praia Vale Centeanes. It offers hikers an opportunity to experience some of Portugal's most breathtaking and dramatic coastal landscapes.



Here's a description of the trail:

Starting Point:
The trail begins at Praia da Marinha viewpoint, one of the most iconic and picturesque beaches in Portugal. The beach is easily accessible by car and offers ample parking. From here, you'll find the trailhead that leads you to the first of the seven hanging valleys.

Cliff-top Path:
The trail follows a well-marked and well-maintained cliff-top path that winds its way along the coastline. The views from the path are simply stunning, with rugged limestone cliffs dropping steeply into the turquoise waters of the Atlantic Ocean.

Seven Hanging Valleys:
As the name suggests, the trail takes you through seven hanging valleys, which are deep and narrow ravines that descend from the cliffs down to secluded sandy beaches below. Each valley offers its own unique charm and distinct views of the coastal scenery.

Breathtaking Scenery:
Throughout the hike, you'll be treated to breathtaking views of the dramatic cliffs, hidden coves, ssinkholes, and rock formations that have been shaped by the relentless power of the ocean over millions of years. The contrasting colors of the golden cliffs, green vegetation, and blue sea create a mesmerizing and colorful tapestry of nature.


Photography Opportunities:
The Seven Hanging Valleys trail is a paradise for photographers. There are numerous spots along the way to capture postcard-worthy images of the coastline, cliffs, and crystal-clear waters.

Difficulty Level:
While the trail is relatively well-maintained and accessible, it does involve some hiking on uneven terrain and can be moderately challenging in certain sections. It's essential to wear suitable footwear and take caution while walking along the cliff edges.

Duration:
The full hike can take around 4 hours, depending on your pace and the time spent at various viewpoints and beaches. This is a linear route and includes a car transportation to the starting point.


As with any outdoor activity, it's important to consider safety precautions, carry enough water, wear sunscreen, suitable footwear for hiking, and be aware of weather conditions. Also, remember to respect the natural environment and follow any posted signs or guidelines to help preserve this beautiful area for future visitors.

title: Sunset Benagil Caves Boat Tour - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Experience the magic of the Algarve coastline at sunset on this unforgettable boat tour to the world-famous Benagil Caves and some of the region’s most spectacular coastal treasures. As the sun begins to set over the Atlantic Ocean, the cliffs, sea caves, and hidden beaches are bathed in stunning shades of gold, orange, and pink, creating a truly unforgettable atmosphere.

Board a comfortable sightseeing boat and cruise along one of Portugal’s most beautiful coastlines while enjoying panoramic views and the peaceful ambiance of the late afternoon. Along the way, discover around 10 sea caves and several secluded beaches accessible only from the water, revealing a side of the Algarve that few get to experience.

The highlight of the journey is the iconic Benagil Cave, one of Portugal’s most extraordinary natural wonders. Admire its impressive dome, natural skylight, and the magical reflections dancing on the crystal-clear water. You'll also pass by famous landmarks such as Praia da Marinha, often ranked among Europe’s most beautiful beaches, and the stunning Albandeira Arch.

As twilight approaches, the coastline becomes even more enchanting. The warm glow of the setting sun transforms the rock formations and turquoise waters into a breathtaking landscape, offering incredible opportunities for unforgettable photos.

Throughout the tour, your experienced local crew will share fascinating insights into the geology, history, and natural beauty of the Algarve coast, adding depth to this relaxing and scenic experience.

Perfect for couples, families, photographers, and nature lovers, this sunset cruise offers a unique and memorable way to discover the Algarve from the sea.

As the tour draws to a close, sit back, relax, and enjoy the peaceful return to Armação de Pêra while the final colors of the sunset fade over the horizon: the perfect ending to an unforgettable evening on the Algarve coast.
highlights: Enjoy a magical sunset cruise along the Algarve coast
Visit the iconic Benagil Cave in golden evening light
Discover hidden beaches and spectacular sea caves
Admire Praia da Marinha and the stunning Albandeira Arch
Capture unforgettable sunset views and coastal landscapes
goodToKnow: Please arrive at least 20 minutes before departure to ensure a smooth check-in. We recommend bringing sunscreen, sunglasses, a hat, and comfortable clothing suitable for a boat trip. Don’t forget your camera to capture the spectacular coastline, hidden beaches, and sea caves.

This experience is subject to weather and sea conditions and may be rescheduled or canceled for safety reasons. Access to the Benagil Cave is also dependent on sea conditions and instructions from local maritime authorities.
Children must be accompanied by an adult at all times. For everyone’s safety and comfort, please follow all instructions provided by the captain and crew throughout the tour.

description:
Experience the natural beauty of the Algarve on a full-day trip from Lisbon, designed to balance iconic sights with a relaxed pace.

Travel south in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle and arrive at the Algarve coast. Your first stop is Benagil, home to one of Portugal’s most famous natural landmarks. Admire the Benagil Sea Cave from a panoramic cliff-top viewpoint and enjoy time at the nearby beach. An optional boat tour to see the cave from the sea is available (weather and availability permitting, extra cost).

Continue to Carvoeiro, where you’ll explore the dramatic rock formations and coastal paths of Algar Seco, including natural arches and ocean viewpoints.

In the afternoon, head to Lagos, one of the Algarve’s most charming towns. Enjoy free time for lunch, explore the historic old town, or relax by the sea. End the visit with a stop at Ponta da Piedade, famous for its golden cliffs and rock formations overlooking the Atlantic Ocean.

Travel back to Lisbon in the evening after a full day of coastal scenery and unforgettable views.

title: Portimão: Benagil Full Caves + Meal @ Allgarbe, a Local Gem - 2026 (Verified Reviews)
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey along the Algarve coast, starting at the Portimão pier. After a brief but essential safety briefing, hop aboard a RIB boat and set out to explore the region’s stunning coastal landscapes.

As you glide across the water, enjoy panoramic views of the majestic Fort of Santa Catarina and the fairytale-like castle of Ferragudo, both standing proudly above the sea. Cruise past picturesque fishing villages where time seems to slow down and traditional seaside life still thrives.

The adventure continues as you approach the Algarve’s dramatic cliffs and sea caves, sculpted over millennia by wind and waves. Each formation tells a story, with natural arches and hidden chambers waiting to be discovered. The highlight of your trip is the breathtaking Benagil Cave — a natural gem accessible only by sea. Marvel at the skylight above as golden rays pour onto the sandy beach below, creating a truly magical atmosphere. The echoes and whispers of the sea amplify the sense of wonder.

If you’ve selected the sunset tour, your return journey becomes even more special. As the sun dips below the horizon, the sky bursts into a palette of colours, casting a golden glow over the Atlantic and offering a perfect finale to your boat adventure.

To complete your experience, enjoy a meal at Allgarbe, a stylish restaurant located in the heart of the city. This unbeatable combo brings together a top-rated boat tour with a meal at the best-rated restaurant in the Algarve, offering you the perfect balance of exploration and indulgence.

Your ticket includes a fish & curry dish, a fusion-style option that isn’t traditional to the Algarve but has become one of the restaurant’s most popular signatures. Prefer something else? No problem — alternative dishes are available for guests with different tastes, including kid-friendly meal options.
The meal can be reserved separately for lunch or dinner, depending on your schedule and the restaurant.
